$comment: Achievement diaries. Per diary: 'index' (diary tab row, cache enum 595), the varbits the cache's diary scripts read (56: started/complete, 2200: count/total/reward; Karamja's legacy easy-hard tiers are complete at 2), each tier's tasks exactly as OSRS writes them in the journal (with its line wrapping), the literal journal lines around them, the reward items and lamp, and the claim conversation from the Wiki transcript ('reward' marks when the items are given). 'npcAt' is how messages name the reward NPC; only Ardougne's and the captured reminder lines are verified, the rest follow the Wiki's location. Task text and layout: rsprox capture of every diary's journal; varbits: cache; rewards: Wiki.

diaries.npcAt: Pirate Jackie the Fruit in Brimhaven

volcano.

without the use of Extracts.

claim.player: I've done all the elite tasks in my Karamja Achievement Diary.

claim.npc: Arr, that be an incredible achievement, so it be! I suppose ye'll be wanting yer reward upgraded again.

claim.npc: I can see that, well done! You've completed all of the tasks in the Lumbridge & Draynor diary! You've earned another reward.

I've upgraded your Explorer's ring for you. In addition to the previous benefits you can now block an additional slayer target with slayer masters, recharge all of your run energy three times per day and cast high
level alchemy thirty times per day. The Culinaromancer's chest is now 20% cheaper and you'll receive double wire when thieving in Dorgesh-Kaan.

lines: Craft any Snelm from scratch in Morytania.
Cook a thin Snail on the Port Phasmatys range.

Enter Mort Myre Swamp.

Place a Scarecrow in the Morytania flower patch.
Offer some bonemeal at the Ectofuntus.
Kill a werewolf in its human form using the Wolfbane
Dagger.
Restore your prayer points at the nature altar.

claim.player: I've completed all of the easy tasks in my Morytania Achievement Diary!

claim.npc: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!

These platelegs are a symbol of your exploration of Morytania. You can use them to teleport to the Slime pit beneath the Ectofuntus twice a day, there's a chance Ghasts will ignore you in the swamp, and you'll receive
a 2.5% increase in Slayer XP when on assignment in the Slayer Tower too.
If you ever lose them, come back to me to reclaim them.

furnace.

Use an ectophial to return to Port Phasmatys.
Mix a Guthix Balance potion while in Morytania.

claim.player: I've completed all of the medium tasks in my Morytania achievement diary!

claim.npc: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!

I've upgraded your Morytania legs for you. They've now got 5 daily slime pit teleports and a built-in ghostspeak amulet. Robin in Port Phasmatys will exchange some bonemeal for bones for you, and you'll
receive a 5% increase in Slayer XP when on assignment in the Slayer Tower too.

Climb the advanced spike chain within Slayer Tower.
Harvest some Watermelon from the Allotment patch on

Canifis.
Pray at the Altar of Nature with Piety activated.
Use the shortcut to get to the bridge over the Salve.
Mine some Mithril ore in the Abandoned Mine.

claim.player: I've completed all of the hard tasks in my Morytania achievement diary!

claim.npc: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!
I've upgraded your Morytania legs for you. You can now pick double Mort Myre Fungi in the swamp, get more experience from burning shades, receive more runes from Barrows, Robin will exchange more
bonemeal for bones each day and you'll receive a 7.5% increase in Slayer XP when on assignment in the Slayer Tower. The disciples at the Ectofuntus have something for you too.

lines: Catch a shark in Burgh de Rott with your bare hands.
Cremate any Shade remains on a Magic or Redwood pyre.
Fertilize the Morytania herb patch using Lunar Magic.
Craft a Black dragonhide body in Canifis bank.
Kill an Abyssal demon in the Slayer Tower.
Loot the Barrows chest while wearing any complete
barrows set.

claim.player: I've completed all of the elite tasks in my Morytania achievement diary!

claim.npc: I can see that, well done! You've completed all of the tasks in Morytania! Here's your reward!

I've upgraded your Morytania legs for you. Robin will exchange even more bonemeal for bones, you'll receive a 10% increase in Slayer XP when on assignment in the Slayer Tower, there's a new herb farming patch on
Harmony Island, you'll receive 50% more experience when cremating shade remains and the experience provided by the Bonecrusher has been increased too.

furnace. Zaff will stock 15 Battlestaves per day.

will stock 60 Battlestaves per day and you can now access the bank at the Cooking guild.

Use Lunar magic to make 20 mahogany planks at the
Lumberyard.
Bake a summer pie in the Cooking Guild.
Smith and fletch ten rune darts within Varrock.
Craft 100 or more earth runes simultaneously from

stock 120 Battlestaves per day and the plate functions as a Prospector top.

diaries.npcAt: the Lesser Fanatic east of the Edgeville jailhouse

claim.npc: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!

This sword is a symbol of your exploration of the Wilderness. Speak to Lundail at the Mage Arena every day to receive 40 free runes and you can teleport to either Edgeville or Ardougne from the Wilderness lever.
If you ever lose your sword, come back to me to reclaim it.

Chop some yew logs from a fallen Ent.
Enter the Wilderness Godwars Dungeon.
Complete a lap of the Wilderness Agility course.
Kill a Green Dragon.

claim.npc: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!

I've upgraded your Wilderness Sword for you. Mandrith will give you a 20% discount off entry to the Resource Area, you'll cut Ents faster, you can access a shortcut in the deep Wilderness dungeon. You'll also
receive increase rewards from the chests in Rogues' Castle, and you can also now own 4 ecumenical keys and receive 80 runes a day from Lundail.

lines: Cast one of the 3 God spells against another player in the
Wilderness.
Charge an Air Orb.
Catch a Black Salamander in the Wilderness.
Smith an Adamant scimitar in the Resource Area.
Kill a Lava Dragon.
Kill the Chaos Elemental.
Kill the Crazy Arc. Chaos Fanatic & Scorpia.
Take the agility shortcut from Trollheim into the
Wilderness.
Kill a Spiritual warrior in the Wilderness Godwars Dungeon.
Fish some Raw Lava Eel in the Wilderness.

claim.player: I've completed all of the hard tasks in my Wilderness Achievement Diary!

claim.npc: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!
I've upgraded your Wilderness Sword for you. It can now teleport you to the Fountain of Rune once per day.
You'll also get 50% more lava shards when grinding scales and even cheaper access to the Resource Area.
You can now own 5 ecumenical keys, and Lundail will give you 120 free runes each day.
You can also telegrab Wine of Zamorak from spanws in the Wilderness in banknote for, and control which Obelisk you want to travel to.
You'll also receive further increased rewards from the chests in Rogues' Castle. Finally, I'll be willing to buy ecumenical keys off you for 61,500 coins each.
Finally, you can now access the lairs of Artio, Spindel and Calvar'ion, three fearsome Wilderness bosses, without requiring a Slayer assignment.

lines: Kill Callisto, Venenatis & Vet'ion.
Teleport to Ghorrock.
Fish and Cook a Dark Crab in the Resource Area.
Smith a rune scimitar from scratch in the Resource Area.
Steal from the Rogues' chest.
Slay a spiritual mage inside the wilderness Godwars
Dungeon.
Cut and burn some magic logs in the Resource Area.

claim.npc: I can see that, well done! You've completed all of the tasks in the Wilderness! Here's your reward!

I've upgraded your Wilderness Sword for you. Access to the Resource Area is now free and the sword will now give you unlimited teleports to the Fountain of Rune. All dragon bone drops in the Wilderness are now
noted and Lundail will give you 200 free runes per day and the rate at which you catch Dark Crabs has been increased.

claim.npc: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!
I've upgraded your Western banner for you. The Crystal saw will now last for twice as long before reverting to seed, you now have a 50% chance of 2 Chompy birds appearing when hunting and Rantz will
provide you with 50 free ogre arrows every day.

claim.npc: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!
I've upgraded your Western banner for you. Ilfeen of the Elves can now enchant your crystal seed into a Halberd, a locked door under Ape Atoll has been unlocked, The Void Knights can now upgrade your

Void armour, the Hunter master in the Feldip hills will allow you to hunt in his private hunting ground, teleport crystals can now hold 5 charges, Rantz will provide you with 100 ogre arrows every day and the banner will
teleport you to Piscatoris once per day.

Kill the Thermonuclear Smoke devil <col=800000>(Does not require task)<col=000000>.

I've upgraded your Western banner for you. Two Chompy birds will now always appear and they have a chance of dropping a pet, [Nieve/Steve] will reward your slayer assignments with more points and Rantz will provide
you with 150 free ogre arrows every day. The banner will teleport you to Piscatoris as much as you desire and you may resurrect once per day while battling Zulrah.

diaries.npcAt: Elise in the courtyard of Kourend Castle

lines: Mine some Iron at the Mount Karuulm mine.
Kill a Sandcrab.
Hand in a book at the Arceuus Library.
Steal from a Hosidius Food Stall.

claim.npc: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!

This blessing is a symbol of your exploration of Great Kourend and the Kebos Lowlands. You now have a 2% chance of catching two fish at once while using the blessing. It also provides 3 daily teleports to the

Kourend Woodland. On top of that, you can access Crabclaw Island for half the price, lizardmen are more likely to drop a Xeric's talisman, the people of Hosidius will protect your farming patches for free, you'll be able
to use the Hosidius Kitchens and Eodan in the Forthos Dungeon will now tan hide for you at 8 times the normal price down from 10 times.
If you ever lose your blessing, come back to me to reclaim it.

Great Kourend.

Catch a Bluegill on Molch Island.
Use the boulder leap in the Arceuus essence mine.
Subdue the Wintertodt.
Catch a Chinchompa in the Kourend Woodland.
Chop some Mahogany logs north of the Farming Guild.

claim.npc: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!

I've upgraded your Rada's blessing for you. You now have a 4% chance of catching two fish at once while using the blessing. It also provides 5 daily teleports to the Kourend Woodland. On top of that, you'll have a

5% chance to mine two dense essence blocks at once, Thirus will give you 20 free Dynamite per day and Eodan in the Forthos Dungeon will now tan hide for you at 6 times the normal price down from 8 times.

Quidamortem.

claim.npc: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!

I've upgraded your Rada's blessing for you. You now have a 6% chance of catching two fish at once while using the blessing. It also provides unlimited teleports to the Kourend Woodland and 3 daily teleports to Mount

Karuulm. On top of that, Captain Cleive will show you how to use a Slayer helmet in place of a Shayzien helm, you'll get a 5% increase in yield from the Hosidius and Farming Guild Herb patches, Thirus will give you 40
free Dynamite per day, Eodan in the Forthos Dungeon will now tan hide for you at 4 times the normal price down from 6 times and Tyss at the Dark Altar will give you an ash sanctifier too.

fragments.

Farming Guild.

claim.player: I've completed all of the elite tasks in my Kourend & Kebos Achievement Diary!

claim.npc: I can see that, well done! You've completed all of the tasks in the Kourend & Kebos area! Here's your reward!

I've upgraded your Rada's blessing for you. You now have an 8% chance of catching two fish at once while using the blessing. It also provides unlimited teleports to the Kourend Woodland and to Mount Karuulm. On

top of that, Konar quo Maten will give you 20 Slayer Points per task rather than 18, you'll be 10% less likely to burn food at the Hosidius City Kitchens, you'll get 10% more Blood runes when Runecrafting, you'll no

longer need to wear heat protection inside the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon, Thirus will give you 80 free Dynamite per day, Eodan in the Forthos Dungeon will now tan hide for you at 2 times the normal price down
from 4 times and the experience provided by the ash sanctifier is increased too, and finally you'll be more likely to gain higher tiered ores from Blast Mining.
